conflict_synopsis.core_view: This week's broadening G10 tightening plus a reduced CAD oil-supply tail is the live path for CAD to keep cheapening versus USD while the extreme CA-US rate gap persists.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Fed/BoJ/hawkish-BoE decision week plus the 16 Sep Saudi workaround keep the CA-US 2Y gap from closing via BoC.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: Canadian core reaccelerates via named energy pass-through, or CAD yields close the CA-US 2Y gap the other way.

remit: credible path from mispricing to repricing
stance_summary: This week's broadening G10 tightening plus a reduced CAD oil-supply tail is the live path for CAD to keep cheapening versus USD while the extreme CA-US rate gap persists; housing-stretched AUDNZD is a valuation fade without a usable NZ rates catalyst.

catalysts: BoE hold at 3.75% on 17 Sep with three hike votes
18 Sep last24 desk thesis that global tightening is broadening
16 Sep Saudi workaround reducing CAD's extreme oil-supply tail
evidence_refs: rollup:BoC minutes flag higher energy pass-through risk
trade.horizon: event-driven, 1-4 weeks through the next Canadian CPI/BoC communication window after this G10 decision week
trade.invalidation: Thesis is wrong if Canadian core reaccelerates via the energy pass-through named in BoC minutes, or if the energy shock-absorber warning reasserts and CAD yields close the CA-US 2Y gap.
trade.mispricing: CA-US 2Y at -140bp (1y percentile 3.8, 5y percentile 4.3) prices a durable BoC easing/hold gap versus a Fed that has just hiked; USDCAD at ECB reference 1.4010 is only 74th percentile on 1y, so FX has not fully treated that policy gap as a completed CAD-weakness event.
principal_risks: The Fed hike was already >90% priced
Retained energy research still has crude near $110
CA activity temperature 53.2 is the strongest of the four countries
trade.structure: outright spot USDCAD as the FX expression of persistent CA-US 2Y cheapness of CAD rates
trade.thesis: The dated mechanism is this week's already-fired G10 tightening sequence (Fed hike 16 Sep, BoJ hike 17 Sep, hawkish BoE 6-3 hold 17 Sep) plus the 16 Sep Saudi workaround that cuts CAD's extreme oil-supply tail, transmitted through a CA-US 2Y gap of -140bp that is near five-year extremes while BoC still lacks a live hike catalyst because August core is near 2%.
why_now: The hike itself is known information; the new transmission is BoJ +25bp to 1.25% on 17 Sep and a non-dovish BoE 6-3 hold the same day.

Canada-specific overlay is dated 14-16 Sep: August CPI held at 3% with core near 2%, BoC minutes flagged energy pass-through as a risk rather than a delivered hike, and the Saudi workaround reduced the extreme oil-supply tail.
Reject fading 5y-extreme AUDNZD/AUDCAD as the trade: NZ sovereign yields are unavailable and NZ Q2 GDP beat forecasts.
